arStrings.szText: {c_important}Blood Lance{/c} deals {c_number}[SF_7*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage to enemies it hits per lanced enemy.

Every {c_number}3rd{/c} cast of {c_important}Blood Lance{/c} forms a {c_important}{u}Blood Orb{/c}{/u} under the first enemy hit.

Casting {c_important}Blood Lance{/c} will pick up a {c_important}{u}Blood Orb{/c}{/u} around you and conjure an additional lance from it, dealing {c_number}[SF_14*100|%|]{/c} of normal damage.

{c_important}Blood Lance{/c} becomes a {c_important}Darkness{/c} Skill and deals Shadow damage.

Enemies hit are permanently lanced and the lance deals {c_number}{dot:TOOLTIP_DARKNESS_DOT}{/c} Corrupting damage per second to them.

{c_important}Blood Lance{/c} {c_important}{u}Fortifies{/c}{/u} you for {c_number}[{SF_23}*100|%|]{/c} of your Maximum Life {c_number}([Max(1,{fortified:MOD_FORTIFY})|0|]){/c} if it hits an enemy already lanced.
{c_important}Blood Lance's{/c} Essence cost is reduced by {c_number}{SF_33}{/c}.
{c_important}Blood Lance{/c} consumes {c_number}{SF_13}{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/c}{/u} to throw an additional lance, dealing {c_number}[SF_12*100|%|]{/c} of normal damage.
